rationale: A selective catalytic inhibitor is the chemical equivalent of a knockout: it removes PRMT7 function, so SGC3027 should reproduce the deletion and expand CD8+ cells. The degrader is the outlier. PROTACs act at micromolar concentrations over three days, recruit a ubiquitin ligase to whatever else they encounter, and their linkers are poorly tolerated, so the collapse of the CD8+ compartment to about 11% is the signature of degrader toxicity rather than of PRMT7 biology.
